h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Korba

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Korba

items.pText: Korba is the power and coal centre of Chhattisgarh, and many of the families here live in townships run by power plants and mining companies. Those colonies need play areas that hundreds of children use every evening, maintained by an estate office rather than a parent committee. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment for such sites at our Vasai factory, about 1,070 km away by road.

Township and company buyers usually need clear paperwork before a purchase is approved. We send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked, an itemised quote and the warranty terms, so the proposal can go through your internal process. Once approved, we manufacture, dispatch and install the equipment with our team or a dealer in central India.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Planning a play area for a Korba township

c: Township playgrounds take heavy, daily use, so spread the load. One larger structure from our

range draws the older children, while swings, see-saws and spring riders in a separate corner keep toddlers out of the busiest traffic. Fine coal dust and hot summers are a fact of life here, which is one reason we use galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts that wipe clean.

items.q: Can you provide documents for a company or township purchase in Korba?
items.a: Yes. We share a layout drawing with the safe play area marked, an itemised quote and our warranty terms. These usually cover what an estate or purchase department needs to review.

items.q: How should we handle dust on the equipment?
items.a: Wipe or hose down slides and decks regularly and sweep the flooring. Roto-moulded plastic and galvanised steel clean easily and do not hold dust the way rough paint does.

Three years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope, and one year on springs, bearings and spare parts, for manufacturing defects under normal installation and maintenance.
